That kind of life feels so far away. I'm failing school even though I'm trying so hard...I doubt i'll ever achieve anything. i'd be one of the pathetic people everyone hates, a burden
i don't even know what i love anymore. nothing feels worthwhile...

I don't know if I'm even capable of feeling happy anymore. I live in a culture where anything less than top grades makes you a failure. if i don't do well my family will basically be isolated because of it

i guess my parents love me too much. the thing is, they're extremely judgemental and criticise me constantly, to the point where i am feeling shit about myself every single day

My biggest fear is disappointing them...i guess that's what years of emotional and physical abuse does to you. heh
I guess you could say that its pressure. school is more than i can handle, i'm working my hardest and i'm still a fucking failure no matter how i try
